author: Kushal
problem: A vineyard numbers the days of its harvest from 1; week 1 is the first seven days, week 2 the next seven, and so on. picked_days lists the days on which grapes were picked. Return a dict mapping each week to how many picking days it had.
bug_description: Uses day // 7 + 1 instead of (day - 1) // 7 + 1, so the last day of every week (7, 14, ...) is put in the following week.

comments.accurate: Counts picking days in each harvest week, seven days to a week starting from day 1
comments.wrong_behavior: Counts picking days per week, where a day's week is its number of completed weeks plus one
comments.wrong_location: Week calculation checked; weeks with no picking days may be missing from the result
